description: Compare one to twelve public Hyatus listing slugs when shortlisting stays for the same dates and guest count. Unavailable homes remain in the comparison so their limitations stay visible. Read an individual stay or its dated price for the next decision; comparison does not reserve a home.

bedrooms.description: Minimum bedrooms, such as '2' or '2+'. 'Studio' or '0' selects zero bedrooms. Omit or use an empty string for no preference.

checkIn.description: Local arrival date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with no time or UTC conversion. Supply checkOut too.

checkOut.description: Local departure date in YYYY-MM-DD format, after checkIn and at most 366 nights later. Checkout day is not an occupied night. Supply checkIn too.

guests.description: Guest count as a whole-number string from '1' to '100', used to compare each home's capacity. Omit for a comparison without a guest requirement.

slugs.description: One to twelve distinct public listing slugs from search results or Hyatus listing URLs, in the desired comparison order.

items.description: Public listing slug from a Hyatus search result or listing URL, not an internal ID or full URL.

name: compare_hyatus_stays
title: Compare furnished stays
